steps.title: Get a nether star
steps.say: Defeating the [Wither](mob:wither) drops a [nether star](item:nether_star). The Wither is a very strong boss, so get help from a grown-up or a friend.

steps.title: Craft the beacon
steps.say: Put the [nether star](item:nether_star) in the middle, 5 [glass](item:glass) around the top, and 3 [obsidian](item:obsidian) along the bottom.

steps.title: Build the base
steps.say: Make a 3 by 3 square of 9 [blocks of iron](item:iron_block), gold, [emerald](item:emerald) or [diamond](item:diamond). You can mix them.

steps.title: Put the beacon on top
steps.say: Place the beacon in the middle of the square. Nothing can block the sky above it, except [glass](item:glass).

steps.title: Pick a power
steps.say: Open the beacon, pick a power like speed or haste, and pay with an [iron ingot](item:iron_ingot), [gold ingot](item:gold_ingot), [emerald](item:emerald) or [diamond](item:diamond).

steps.title: Make it stronger
steps.say: Add bigger layers under it: 5 by 5, then 7 by 7, then 9 by 9. Each one unlocks more powers.
